metadata.name: launchpad
metadata.description: Stonkz bonding-curve launchpad: 20/70/10 on-chain fee split, $69K graduation

instructions.name: buy
docs: `amount_base` in, at least `min_out` tokens back. Slippage is enforced
on this hop alone; the aggregator hop carries its own bound.

instructions.name: claim_creator_fees
docs: Creator bucket only. Cannot reach the protocol or ops vaults.

instructions.name: claim_dex_fees
docs: Permissionless crank: claim the locked DLMM position's swap fees into
the curve's own 15 / 10 / 6 / 69 split, so post-bond fees keep flowing
to the protocol, the buyback, the crate fund, the creator and stakers.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Mutable: the token side's non-bucket legs are burned.

accounts.name: position
docs: (program-owned, this pool, escrow as owner and fee owner).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone. Pays the transaction fee and receives nothing.

instructions.name: claim_referral
docs: Redeem an API-signed voucher for `cumulative_amount` (lifetime) base
atoms: pays the difference over what this recipient already claimed.
The transaction must carry an `Ed25519Program` verification of the
voucher message by the configured signer before this instruction.

accounts.name: claim_state
docs: The recipient's lifetime-claimed counter for this base mint. Rent is
the recipient's: they are the one being paid.

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: The recipient's ATA for the base mint, created here if missing with
the recipient's lamports (they are the one being paid). Measured
smaller than requiring a client-side create (830,136 vs 903,816 B).

accounts.name: bucket_base_vault
docs: The pool's money and the creator's money live in the same vault, told
apart by the `Curve` ledger. Neither can overdraw the other.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Mint PDA is seeded on creator + salt so the same ticker can launch
more than once. Uniqueness of display name/ticker is an app-layer
cooldown, not an on-chain permanent bind.

accounts.name: curve_token_vault
docs: Holds the 80% sellable allocation.

accounts.name: lp_vault
docs: Holds the 20% escrowed for the graduation pool.

accounts.name: curve_base_vault
docs: Holds base paid into the curve.

accounts.name: bucket_base_vault
docs: The 69% bucket, in base. Creator claim and staker pool share it; the
ledger on `Curve` says how much of the balance belongs to which.

accounts.name: bucket_token_vault
docs: The 69% bucket after a cashback swap, in the launched token.

accounts.name: stake_escrow
docs: Escrow for staked tokens, including zero-weight FLEX positions.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The launched mint's program. Classic SPL Token only: the Metaplex
metadata below is the classic-mint path. The base mint is unaffected
and may still be Token-2022 via `base_token_program`.

accounts.name: metadata
docs: The seeds pin it to `["metadata", metaplex, mint]` under Metaplex.

instructions.name: fund_referral_vault
docs: Anyone may top a referral vault up. The protocol withdraw authority
normally uses `withdraw_treasury(Protocol, amount)` with the referral
vault as `destination` instead.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Optional. Without it only the curve-exhaustion trigger is available,
which is exactly the intended behaviour when the oracle is down.

instructions.name: init_referral_vault
docs: Permissionless: open the referral payout vault for a base mint. Anyone
may pay its rent; opening it grants nothing.

instructions.name: migrate_create_pool
docs: Step 1 of migration: create the Meteora DLMM LB pair at curve close price.

instructions.name: migrate_seed_liquidity
docs: Step 2 of migration: seed liquidity, lock the position permanently.

accounts.name: user_token_x
docs: Escrow ATA for token X (sorted mint order). Client must pass the matching escrow ATA.

accounts.name: user_token_y
docs: Escrow ATA for token Y (sorted mint order).

accounts.name: rent
docs: `initialize_position_pda` takes the rent sysvar.

instructions.name: pause
docs: The pauser can set pause flags and nothing else; unpausing is admin's
`set_pause`.

instructions.name: sell
docs: `amount_token` in, at least `min_out` base back **after** the curve fee.

instructions.name: set_meteora_config
docs: Which Meteora DLMM program and `PresetParameter2` migration CPIs into.

instructions.name: set_pauser
docs: Admin appoints the emergency pauser (default pubkey removes it).

instructions.name: set_raydium_config
docs: Deprecated alias — same Global slots as `set_meteora_config`.

instructions.name: set_referral_paused
docs: Admin or the emergency pauser may pause referral claims; only admin
may unpause.

accounts.name: pauser_config
docs: Absent when no pauser was ever appointed; then only admin may call.

instructions.name: set_referral_signer
docs: Admin: the API's Ed25519 voucher signer, the daily cap (base atoms;
`0` refuses all, `u64::MAX` uncapped) and the 8-byte cluster tag.

instructions.name: sync_price_from_pyth
docs: Permissionless: copy the base mint's pinned Pyth feed (a verified
`PriceUpdateV2`) into its `BaseOracle`. A not-newer update is a no-op.
Appended last so every existing instruction keeps its position.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Same PDA and layout `push_price` writes; created on the first sync.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: the Pyth receiver program, Anchor discriminator, `Full` verification,
and the feed id pinned for `base_mint` in `pyth::PYTH_FEEDS`. Any such
account is genuine Wormhole-verified Pyth data, so its address is not
pinned (sponsored push feed or a caller-posted update both work).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent only when the `BaseOracle` does not exist yet.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Must equal `global.protocol_withdraw_authority` or
`global.ops_withdraw_authority` depending on `which`. Documented to be a
multisig or cold key; the API process holds neither.

types.name: BaseOracle
docs: A pushed USD price for one base mint.

fields.name: price_1e6
docs: USD per whole base token, scaled 1e6.

fields.name: conf_1e6
docs: Confidence band in the same scale.

types.name: Curve
docs: One launched coin: its curve, its fee ledger, and its stake pool.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Creator-set curve fee, 100–500 bps.

fields.name: cb_start
docs: Set once by the program at creation. No instruction can move it, so the
5-minute window cannot be extended by any client.

fields.name: grad_mcap_base
docs: Base atoms equal to $69,000 at the price read when the coin launched.

fields.name: complete
docs: Allocation exhausted: no further buys, awaiting `graduate`.

fields.name: migrated
docs: Set once `migrate_seed_liquidity` has deposited reserves into the
escrow-owned Meteora DLMM position. Once true, `real_base` /
`lp_reserve` are zero and seeding refuses to run again.

fields.name: dex_pool
docs: Meteora DLMM `LbPair` address. Set by `migrate_create_pool`; verifiable
independently on a block explorer. Layout-compatible rename of
`raydium_pool`.

fields.name: dex_position_meta
docs: Packed migration meta: lower 32 bits = `lower_bin_id` as u32 bit pattern,
upper 32 bits = position `width` as u32. Enough to re-derive the DLMM
position PDA with the escrow as base. Replaces `raydium_lp_burned`.

fields.name: creator_claimable_base
docs: Claimable by the creator, base mint. Never includes protocol or ops.

fields.name: creator_claimable_token
docs: Claimable by the creator, launched token. Cashback window only.

fields.name: eligible_staked
docs: Staked amount with a lock of at least 1 day. FLEX is excluded so a
zero-weight position cannot dilute `poolFrac`.

fields.name: flex_staked
docs: FLEX escrow. Parked, zero weight, excluded from `poolFrac`.

fields.name: pool_dust_base
docs: Rewards accrued but not yet divisible across the pool. Held, not lost.

types.name: DexFeesClaimed
docs: Fees claimed from the escrow-held Meteora DLMM position and routed
through the curve's own split. Base-side legs go to the same per-base-mint
treasuries as curve fees; the launched-token side has no treasury, so its
non-bucket legs are burned and only the 69% bucket (creator + stakers) is
credited in tokens.

fields.name: caller
docs: Whoever cranked it. Permissionless.

types.name: FeeAccrued
docs: Matches the indexer's `FeeAccrued` — the 15/10/6/69 view on its own, for
reconciliation against `Trade`.

types.name: Global
docs: Program-wide configuration and the pause switches.
`admin`, `protocol_withdraw_authority` and `ops_withdraw_authority` are
three separate keys on purpose. The admin can pause but cannot move money;
the two withdraw authorities can move money but cannot pause. Neither
withdraw authority may be a server hot key — see SPEC.md §4.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin handover; `Pubkey::default()` when no handover is open.

fields.name: protocol_withdraw_authority
docs: Multisig / cold key. Withdraws protocol revenue.

fields.name: ops_withdraw_authority
docs: Multisig / cold key, distinct from the protocol one. Withdraws ops.

fields.name: oracle_authority
docs: Pushes base-mint USD prices. A Pyth/Switchboard crank in production.

fields.name: migration_authority
docs: Runs migration after a graduation: creates the Meteora DLMM pool and
permanently locks the position. See SPEC.md §5.

fields.name: dex_program
docs: Meteora `lb_clmm` program. Admin-settable via `set_meteora_config`.
Layout-compatible rename of the former `raydium_program` slot.

fields.name: dex_config
docs: Meteora `PresetParameter2` (fee / bin-step tier) every graduation pool
is created under. Layout-compatible rename of `raydium_amm_config`.

fields.name: trading_paused
docs: Halts buy and sell. Does not block claims or unstakes.

fields.name: launch_paused
docs: Halts create_token only.

fields.name: protocol_withdrawals_paused
docs: Runbook switch: stop protocol revenue leaving, trading unaffected.

fields.name: ops_withdrawals_paused
docs: Runbook switch from plan step 141: stop ops funds leaving while trading
and accrual both continue.

fields.name: max_oracle_staleness
docs: Max age, seconds, of an oracle push before graduation pricing refuses it.

fields.name: tokens_burned
docs: Unsold curve tokens burned on an early oracle-triggered graduation.

types.name: LiquidityMigrated
docs: Emitted once per coin, when `migrate_seed_liquidity` deposits into a Meteora
DLMM position and permanently locks it (owner → dead / lock_release = max).
DLMM has no fungible LP mint; `position` is the PositionV2 account.

fields.name: position
docs: DLMM PositionV2 account (replaces the former Raydium `lp_mint` field).

fields.name: lock_release_point
docs: `lock_release_point` on the position. `0`: DLMM's operator timelock is
not available to a non-whitelisted operator (see `graduate.rs` step 4);
permanence is the program escrow owning the position with no withdraw
instruction.

fields.name: position_locked
docs: `1` once the position is held by the per-mint escrow PDA.

types.name: PauserConfig
docs: Who may pause. Separate from `Global` so appointing a pauser never
reallocates the account every instruction reads.

types.name: ReferralClaimState
docs: Lifetime referral amount already paid to one recipient for one base mint
(`["referral_claim", base_mint, recipient]`). A voucher pays
`cumulative_amount - claimed`.

types.name: ReferralClaimed
docs: A referral voucher was redeemed: `amount` left the referral vault for
`recipient`, whose lifetime claimed is now `cumulative_amount`.

types.name: ReferralConfig
docs: Referral payout configuration, appended in its own PDA
(`["referral_config"]`) so no existing account layout changes. Admin sets
`signer` (the API's Ed25519 voucher key), `max_per_day` (base atoms, the
blast radius of a leaked signer; `0` refuses every claim, `u64::MAX`
uncapped) and `cluster_tag`; admin or the pauser sets `paused`.

fields.name: day_start
docs: Start of the rolling day `claimed_today` counts against.

fields.name: cluster_tag
docs: 8-byte cluster marker every voucher carries (`b"mainnet\0"`, …).

types.name: ReferralConfigSet
docs: `set_referral_signer` / `set_referral_paused`: the config after the change.

types.name: ReferralVaultFunded
docs: `fund_referral_vault` (a `withdraw_treasury` into the vault emits
`TreasuryWithdrawn` instead).

types.name: StakePosition
docs: One staker's position in one coin. Seeds bind it to that coin's mint, so
weight in one pool can never settle against another's accumulator.

types.name: TokenCreated
docs: Matches the indexer's `TokenCreated`.

types.name: Trade
docs: Matches the indexer's `Trade`. `fee_*` fields carry the settled split, so
the indexer never has to recompute it.

fields.name: fee_burn
docs: RWA crate fund leg (6%). Historical `burn` name.

fields.name: fee_stakers
docs: The slice of the creator bucket peeled off to this coin's stakers.

fields.name: fee_creator
docs: The rest of the bucket, credited to the creator.

fields.name: cashback_tokens
docs: Non-zero only during cashback: the bucket converted to the token.

types.name: Treasury
docs: Which treasury a withdrawal targets.

types.name: TreasuryCredit
docs: Matches the indexer's `TreasuryCredit`.

fields.name: which
docs: 0 = protocol revenue, 1 = `$STONKZ` ops.
